subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The prescribed minimal fix has been correctly applied — the live_preview configuration block is present in the options object with management_token, enable, and host fields, and the corresponding env vars (CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE, CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST) are destructured at lines 17-24. This matches the root cause analysis exactly. However, no vitest unit tests were added to verify the live_preview configuration is present in the exported options object, that enable defaults to false when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE is not 'true', or that the host defaults to empty string. Per review criteria, new features must have corresponding vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ path. Grep across test/ for live_preview, livePreview, ContentstackContext, ContentstackProvider returned zero results.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a vitest unit test at test/unit/services/contentstack.test.ts that imports the options object and asserts: (1) options.live_preview is defined, (2) options.live_preview.management_token equals CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, (3) options.live_preview.enable is false when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE is unset or not 'true', (4) options.live_preview.host defaults to empty string when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset. Mock process.env as needed.
